summary: Crossfire entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Crossfire
entries.definitive_edition: Current official regional PC client with publisher/server/account state documented

emulation.notes: Online native client; service state controls access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official PC client with exact region/server/event state documented

primary.version: Current regional live client, with server/publisher state documented
primary.why: Crossfire is a regional live-service tactical FPS whose archive state depends on current publisher, server, region, account, events, anti-cheat, and monetization. Regional versions have opened, merged, or closed over time, so the selected live client must be explicit.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official client for the intended region, such as Crossfire West/Z8Games where available. Record publisher/region, client version, account, server, mode/map, weapon/character inventory, event/ranked state, anti-cheat, latency, and whether CrossfireX/Crossfire HD/new Crossfire projects were excluded.

secondary.platform: China / Vietnam / Brazil / other regional clients
secondary.exclusive_content: Region-specific server states, events, and monetization
secondary.what_to_play: Use only when documenting that region specifically.
secondary.why: Regional clients are not interchangeable archive states.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with CrossfireX, Crossfire HD, Crossfire 2, or the separate upcoming single-player Crossfire project.
